about.title: About me
about.introFirst: I'm a Software Developer with over 2 years of experience designing, architecting and building modern applications for web, mobile and desktop. I specialize in the JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystem, using React, React Native, Electron.js and Node.js to turn business requirements into functional, scalable, high-performance solutions.
about.introSecond: I've taken part in the whole software lifecycle: from building applications from scratch, designing their frontend architecture and integrating REST APIs, to technology migration, user experience (UX/UI) optimization and testing.

stats.label: apps optimized in a cross-platform suite

points.text: Designed and implemented the frontend architecture of 4 SaaS applications, integrating REST APIs and building intuitive interfaces aligned with business goals.
Led UX/UI improvements across a suite of 5 applications (web, mobile and desktop), reducing friction in key flows and raising overall usability.
Led the migration of critical dependencies and ran cross-platform functional testing, reducing technical debt and keeping the products stable.
Built a complete on-demand services web application from scratch with React and Firebase, implementing dynamic features that improved user interaction.
Optimized load speed, semantic structure and SEO, and set up CI/CD pipelines to automate deployments and speed up the team's deliveries.
Created software solutions in several languages (Dart, Kotlin, R, Lua), applying functional programming and recursion to solve specific business logic.
Managed version control with Git in remote environments, ensuring clean code integration.
Built end-to-end applications with React, Python (Flask) and MySQL, reinforcing unit and integration testing and solving over 100 logic and data structure challenges.

philosophy.title: My philosophy and professional growth
philosophy.first: Throughout my career I've realized that in this industry there is something new to learn every day. Sometimes progress feels slow or a bit stagnant; yet, looking back at the road traveled, it's incredible to see how much has been built.
philosophy.second: The support of my teammates, constant knowledge sharing and collaborative work have been key to strengthening my skills and adopting better practices: Clean Code, scalable architectures, testing and continuous delivery.
philosophy.third: Along the way I've learned two lessons. Constantly pushing beyond the basics is what keeps me learning and adding real value to every project.
lessons: It can always be done better.
We should never settle for what we already know or practice.
